notes.title: Final update before DSS 2
notes.notes:
Update Change Log

 German translation
 Fixed all reported bugs


Wishlist DSS 2 here
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3582440/DSS_2_War_Industry/

Dev Log
DSS was originally planned as a hobby project, but after over a year of unemployment, I decided to go professional and give it a shot on the market.
I've been reading up on game marketing and have spent a significant part of development making the game more appealing — improving the HUD and allowing city defenses to be built freely, anywhere on the map.
That said, I know I'm working in the "ugly but deep" category of games, so most of the marketing will focus on the demo (coming next month).

Other new features include:

 Three times more resources, buildings, and soldier types
 Skills and a technology tree
 A new villain introduces horde waves
 Tactical controls during battle
 (Maybe multiplayer)

notes.title: Xmas update
notes.notes:
Fighting the build-to-death spiral 
I had no idea how big this issue was until I hired three playtesters to record their play sessions, was shocked by how fast they destroyed their economies.
New players panic when food supplies run low and flood the map with farms. However, the build orders are set to top priority, leaving workers stuck building until they starve.
To address this, I’ve limited the build queue until players upgrade Logistics.

Main feature updates

 Maintaining healthy food production is now much easier.
 More buildings.
 Large sound design overhaul.
 Music playlist.
 40 new named factions, and they have some variations in Ai.
 Cities and Armies can be tagged with icons.

NOTE: Old saves are incompatible (sorry)
I have added a "previous save version" branch (steam client>betas) if you wish to continue playing your existing saves.

notes.title: Update - Chinese localization
notes.notes:
Testing the waters of localization. Have six other languages qued up if it is successful.

French and Arabic commas were outside the font and crashed the game - patched those.
Since games can only view triangles with textures (the trade-off when using GPU), all fonts has to be rendered on an image and I have to limit the amount of charachters that can be shown.
